title: Hardware Troubleshooting Technician
description:
Nova oportunidade para Hardware Troubleshooting Technician em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Overview Hardware Troubleshooting Technician  role at TRACTIAN  Join to apply for the Hardware Troubleshooting Technician role at TRACTIAN. Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features. Why join us TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients. At TRACTIAN, you\'ll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech. The Hardware team The Hardware team is responsible for designing and improving our IoT devices, dealing with every step of the development process, ranging from PCB design, firmware programming, case design, validations and certifications, always aiming to build trustworthy products that can be produced at a mass scale. What You'll Do As a Hardware Troubleshooting Technician, you will play a key role in analyzing, diagnosing, and resolving failures in our devices, ensuring the reliability and quality of our solutions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify root causes, document findings, and contribute to continuous improvements in processes and products. Your hands-on expertise with electronics, mechanics, and measurement tools will be essential to deliver effective outcomes. Responsibilities Troubleshoot and diagnose: Perform in-depth analyses of electronic and mechanical devices, identifying failures following detection standards. Acceptance testing: Execute acceptance tests on electronic and mechanical devices. Documentation: Record written and photographic evidence, document occurrences in specialized software, and maintain detailed reports. Collaboration: Work closely with Logistics, Quality, R&D, and Operations teams to understand failures, propose solutions, and support root cause investigations. Inventory & lab management: Organize and maintain the physical and digital inventory of returned devices and those awaiting disposal, while ensuring the lab remains clean, organized, and fully operational. Continuous improvement: Propose and implement improvements to optimize processes and team routines. Technical expertise: Operate instruments such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic analyzers, microscopes, and other diagnostic tools. Communication: Actively participate in team and department meetings, presenting results and aligning actions with leadership.  Requirements Completed Technical Degree in Electronics. Proven professional experience in electronics troubleshooting, repair, or related areas. Enrollment in a Bachelor\'s degree program in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. Knowledge of electronic circuits, components, and schematic reading. Understanding of mechanical manufacturing processes and basic concepts of hardware and firmware. Ability to interpret electronic technical documents (datasheets, schematics, PCB Gerbers) and mechanical documents (2D technical drawings and work instructions). Hands-on experience with measurement and diagnostic instruments (oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic analyzers, microscopes, etc.). Intermediate English fluency. Live or have availability to move to Sao Paulo.  Bonus Points Experience with scripting languages such as Python. Basic knowledge of programming languages such as C. Experience with other low-level programming languages. Fluency in English proficiency.  Compensation Competitive salary and stock options Optional fully funded English / Spanish courses 30 days of paid annual leave Education and courses stipend Employee Giving Earn a trip anywhere in the world every 4 years Up to R$1.000/mo for meals and remote work allowance Health plan with national coverage and without coparticipation Dental Insurance: we help you with dental treatment for a better quality of life. Gympass and Sports Incentive: R$300/mo extra if you practice activities  Seniority level Entry level  Employment type Full-time  Job function Information Technology  Industries Software Development    #J-18808-Ljbffr

Why join us TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients. At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech. As a CAE Engineer at Tractian, you'll drive the innovation and development of our IIoT solutions. Collaborating across teams, you'll apply your expertise in mechanics and design to create high-performance products that redefine industrial asset management. From concept to execution, your role will shape Tractian's industry-leading technology, ensuring top-tier quality and functionality in every solution we deliver. Responsibilities  Set up and run FEM analyses: linear/nonlinear static, modal transient, random, frequency response, explicit, durability. Analyze vibrational behavior, derive FRFs, and interpret mode shapes to optimize performance. Apply DOE, response surfaces, optimization, and uncertainty analyses to explore design space and quantify risk. Plan and perform tests for model correlation and validation. Partner with test teams on accelerated life testing, translating field data into test requirements and simulation inputs. Script pre/post-processing (Python, MATLAB) to scale studies and improve modeling quality. Document standards, templates, and best practices; propose new methods to capture physics and speed up iteration. Work closely with product development, manufacturing, supplier quality, and production teams, guiding decisions with technical data. Deliver clear reports and presentations explaining assumptions, modeling choices, limitations, and design implications.  Requirements  Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Mechatronics, or related engineering field. Strong understanding of FEM fundamentals, with hands-on experience. Ability to explain model behavior and link results to underlying physics. Experience in test-based model calibration/validation and correlating simulation with experimental data. Knowledge of fatigue analysis and durability assessment. Proficiency in Python and/or MATLAB for data processing, automation, and custom tool development. Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate in a multidisciplinary environment. Proactive, self-directed learner who goes beyond the brief to resolve issues. Advanced English level. Live in or have availability to move to São Paulo.  Bonus points  Expertise in vibration and structural dynamics. Experience in optimization, robust/stochastic design, and uncertainty quantification. Hands-on experience with FEA pre-processing tools and solvers (e.g., Abaqus, Ansys, OptiStruct, Nastran, Radioss, HyperMesh/ANSA).  Compensation:  Competitive salary and stock options Optional fully funded English / Spanish courses 30 days of paid annual leave Education and courses stipend Employee Giving Earn a trip anywhere in the world every 4 years Up to R$1.000/mo for meals and remote work allowance Health plan with national coverage and without coparticipation Dental Insurance: we help you with dental treatment for a better quality of life. Gympass and Sports Incentive: R$300/mo extra if you practice activities  We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all qualified candidates.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Acreditamos na tecnologia que conecta gente boa no que faz e que vive a diversidade para criar e compartilhar até os caminhos que a gente (ainda!) nem sabe quais são. Trabalhamos para gerar valor não só para os nossos usuários, mas, sobretudo, para as comunidades que servimos e toda a sociedade, tornando a vida das pessoas melhor com serviços que facilitem seu dia a dia - seja com serviços de mobilidade e entrega (99) ou pagamentos digitais (99Pay). Para facilitar a vida de milhões de pessoas todos os dias, desde 2018 fazemos parte da DiDi Global Inc., a maior plataforma de tecnologia e transporte por aplicativo do mundo. Somos pioneiros na criação de soluções inovadoras que começam no Brasil e que ganham escala para gerar impacto positivo em mais de 12 países em que a DiDi está presente. Essas inovações passam por sustentabilidade, segurança, inteligência artificial, mercado financeiro e um tanto mais. Seja para construir projetos do zero ou aprimorar nossas soluções, gostamos de desafios que nos fazem sentir frio na barriga, e é por isso que trabalhamos num ritmo acelerado, com respeito, colaboração e bom humor. Nessa jornada, também nos fortalecemos nas diferentes vivências e opiniões para crescermos juntos, errar rápido, aprender e ajustar o caminho para criar soluções que tragam ainda melhores resultados. #LI-Hybrid Team Overview A principal função da nossa equipe de vendas é desenvolver e expandir nosso portfólio de contas, garantindo que eles tenham um bom desempenho na plataforma 99. Através de um excelente atendimento ao cliente e de uma abordagem consultiva, o executivo de vendas deve estabelecer e manter relacionamentos comerciais bem-sucedidos e de longo prazo. Role Responsibilities O principal ponto de contato para nossos parceiros, garantindo uma comunicação próxima e contínua para gerar insights estratégicos, atender às suas necessidades e desenvolver planos de ação para crescimento e uma experiência aprimorada do usuário. Analisando dados e desenvolvendo uma compreensão profunda da dinâmica do mercado e do comportamento dos parceiros para projetar, planejar e implementar estratégias comerciais destinadas a aumentar as vendas. Construindo e promovendo relacionamentos de longo prazo baseados na confiança, com uma mentalidade ganha-ganha para garantir parcerias sustentáveis e mutuamente benéficas.  Role Qualifications Graduação em Administração de Empresas, Marketing, Relações Internacionais, ou áreas relacionadas. 2+ anos de experiência em gestão de contas e vendas consultivas (a senioridade será avaliada ao longo do processo seletivo). Capacidade e flexibilidade para se adaptar e aprender enquanto trabalha em um ambiente de startup em ritmo acelerado, com mudanças constantes e metas desafiadoras. Habilidades interpessoais: Habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de persuadir e manter relações de trabalho construtivas, assertivas, colaborativas e cooperativas com clientes internos e externos em organizações multinacionais. Habilidades analíticas: Capacidade de diagnosticar, compreender tendências de mercado e implementar planos de ação. Senso de urgência e motivação para atingir objetivos enquanto analisa possíveis cenários. Experiência em atingir e superar metas de vendas. Conhecimento intermediário de Excel é um diferencial.  EEO Statement Geramos Valor para os Usuários - Existimos para fazer o melhor para os nossos usuários e inovamos para estarmos sempre na frente. Buscamos o equilíbrio entre experiência, eficiência e crescimento, tendo a segurança sempre em primeiro lugar. Somos Guiados por Dados - Acreditamos na tomada de decisão guiada por dados. Através dos números, navegamos em nosso negócio de forma estratégica. Somos Donos e Focados nos Resultados - Vamos além dos interesses pessoais para focar no que é melhor para a DiDi. Sempre cumprimos o que prometemos e buscamos a excelência na execução, estabelecendo uma barra alta e dando o nosso máximo em tudo que fazemos. Sempre Construímos Juntos - Juntos somos mais fortes. Temos a mente aberta e sempre remamos com respeito, empatia e confiança uns nos outros. Ouvimos a opinião de todos antes de tomar uma decisão e, quando decidimos algo, cumprimos o combinado juntos, mesmo se discordarmos. Somos Íntegros - Integridade é a nossa base e a linha que nunca ultrapassamos. Comunicamos com honestidade, transparência e ouvimos a voz de todos para sempre fazer o que é certo. Desenvolvemos uns aos Outros - Nosso crescimento vem da constante aventura de estarmos fora da nossa zona de conforto. Aceitamos desafios, nos superamos e trabalhamos em busca da excelência em tudo que fazemos. Desde o primeiro dia, nos desenvolvemos e ajudamos as pessoas ao nosso redor a crescerem também, elevando a nossa barra. Trabalhamos com Paixão & Diversão - Somos completamente apaixonados pelo que fazemos. Mantemos um espírito leve e otimista, contagiando o nosso ambiente com energia positiva. Somos resilientes, não temos medo de enfrentar desafios e sempre celebramos nosso sucesso. Vivemos a Diversidade - Para nós, o coração da diversidade é a inclusão, a igualdade e o respeito. Acreditamos que a diversidade promove um ambiente mais criativo e cheio de energia, por isso, celebramos as diferenças e aqui todos podem ser quem são.  Diversidade e Inclusão  Diversidade não é uma visão de futuro ou desejo de algo que queremos um dia, é um valor inegociável de quem somos hoje. Vivemos a inclusão, a pluralidade e o respeito e, para isso, contamos com a governança do Comitê de Diversidade que atua junto com o RH, a nossa liderança e os grupos de identidade - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres e 99Famílias. Essa é a nossa jornada já escrita que ainda tem muito caminho para percorrer. Job description  Sobre Nós:  Facilitando a Realização e Recuperação de Projetos.  A HS Consórcios  é o atalho seguro para milhares de brasileiros conquistarem seus bens. Nosso sucesso é construído na confiança e na transparência. Mas sabemos que a jornada financeira tem seus desafios.  Nossa área de Atendimento e Negociação não é apenas sobre cobrar; é sobre oferecer uma segunda chance . Buscamos pessoas que entendem que a comunicação assertiva e a negociação empática  são a chave para a sustentabilidade do negócio e para a recuperação dos planos  de nossos clientes. Se você tem paixão por encontrar soluções e é movido(a) por resultados, queremos te conhecer!  Venha ser o agente que transforma desafios financeiros em recomeços! Você será a voz da solução, utilizando o telefone como principal ferramenta para atuar com inteligência, cordialidade e assertividade para encontrar a melhor saída para clientes com parcelas em aberto.  Esta função exige uma mente ágil para propor soluções viáveis de renegociação e um coração empático para guiar o cliente de volta ao caminho de seus sonhos.  Você fará parte de um time que investe em desenvolvimento contínuo para garantir a alta performance em comunicação e negociação.  Estamos construindo um banco de talentos com os futuros especialistas em resolução da HS Consórcios!   Seus Principais Desafios Serão:    Ser o solucionador proativo:  Realizar ligações ativas com foco em cobrança e, principalmente, em negociação e resolução, ajudando os clientes a manterem seus planos ativos;  Arquitetar soluções viáveis:  Analisar o cenário de cada cliente para propor as melhores alternativas de renegociação, sempre respeitando as políticas da empresa e a capacidade do cliente;  Promover o atendimento consultivo:  Conduzir o atendimento de forma cordial e assertiva, utilizando a escuta ativa para entender a fundo a situação e guiar o cliente através do script de forma natural e empática, do início ao fechamento do acordo;  Foco em excelência e evolução:  Participar ativamente de treinamentos e feedbacks individuais para garantir a melhoria contínua da sua performance e o atingimento dos indicadores;  Colaboração e alinhamento:  Estar presente em reuniões de alinhamento, capacitação e em ações motivacionais, mantendo-se sempre atualizado(a) sobre as melhores práticas do setor.    Requirements and skills   Ensino Médio completo.  Conhecimento básico em Pacote Office (principalmente Excel), demonstrando organização para gerenciar informações.  Capacidade natural de se comunicar de forma clara, cordial e focada em resultados (negociação).  Perfil motivado por desafios e determinado a superar objetivos.  Experiência prévia em áreas de cobrança, negociação, telemarketing ativo ou call center será considerado um diferencial.    Additional information  Na HS Consórcios , celebramos a vida e a concretização de planos, e isso começa por construir uma cultura onde você é valorizado(a) por quem você é.  Abraçamos a diversidade em seu sentido mais amplo, garantindo um ambiente de respeito e inclusão, acolhendo pessoas de diferentes origens, gêneros, etnias, idades, experiências e formas de pensar.  O QUE OFERECEMOS:    Descontos incríveis através da Associação de Funcionários (parcerias tops na área comercial, saúde, bem-estar e educacional)      Plataforma de atendimento psicológico para fortalecer a mente e o coração!

title: Representante de Desarrollo de Ventas
description:
Nova oportunidade para Representante de Desarrollo de Ventas em florianópolis. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Canonical es una empresa de software global, editora de Ubuntu y soluciones empresariales de código abierto para la nube, desarrolladores, IoT e IA. Ubuntu es la distribución de Linux de más rápido crecimiento y se posiciona como el sistema operativo número uno en la nube. En colaboración con Google, Amazon, IBM y Microsoft, Canonical ayuda a las empresas a ser más ágiles, productivas y a adoptar nuevas tecnologías rápidamente. Ejemplos de éxito incluyen proyectos en IA, Blockchain, IoT, robótica avanzada y vehículos autónomos, donde Ubuntu es la plataforma preferida para el desarrollo. El papel de un representante de desarrollo de ventas en Canonical Canonical es rentable y está en crecimiento. Consideramos que nuestro equipo de desarrollo de ventas es uno de los mejores en el mercado tecnológico, seleccionando candidatos excepcionales y ambiciosos. Disfrutarás este rol si eres organizado, persistente, carismático y trabajador, con interés en la tecnología y sus aplicaciones comerciales. Colaborarás con equipos regionales de ventas y marketing, con el objetivo principal de identificar proyectos de clientes que se ajusten a nuestros productos y promover la marca Canonical en diversas industrias y regiones. Cómo será tu día Atender consultas entrantes de clientes vía email, teléfono y chat. Ejecutar campañas de ventas y marketing salientes. Viajar a eventos y conferencias globales, presentar en stands y promover oportunidades de negocio en persona. Colaborar con múltiples equipos y altos ejecutivos para impulsar resultados. Trabajar con marketing en campañas específicas. Investigar potenciales clientes. Generar un pipeline de ventas de varios millones. Identificar tendencias y oportunidades de mercado. Definir procesos y políticas del equipo. Servir como enlace con nuevos y actuales clientes, organizando reuniones y explorando cuentas para nuevas oportunidades. Crear, mantener y fomentar relaciones con clientes potenciales a nivel global.  Lo que buscamos en ti Excelentes resultados académicos en escuela y universidad. Pasión por los negocios y la tecnología. Compromiso con el aprendizaje y la mejora continua: curioso, flexible y analítico. Capacidad para resolver problemas creativamente y colaborar en equipo. Habilidades de comunicación verbal y escrita. Orientación a resultados y espíritu de superación. Persistencia y perseverancia.  Qué te ofrecemos El salario base dependerá de factores como ubicación, experiencia, conocimientos y habilidades. Además, ofrecemos beneficios adicionales, incluyendo bonificaciones anuales e incentivos por ventas o uso. Nuestra política de compensación busca garantizar justicia y equidad a nivel global. Entre los beneficios adicionales se incluyen: Presupuesto anual de USD 2000 para desarrollo personal y aprendizaje. Revisión salarial anual. Programas de reconocimiento y recompensas. Vacaciones anuales. Licencia parental. Programa de asistencia al empleado. Oportunidades de viaje para conocer colegas en "sprints". Priority Pass y mejoras en viajes para eventos corporativos de larga distancia.  Canonical promueve igualdad de oportunidades. Valoramos la diversidad y fomentamos un ambiente inclusivo donde todos sean considerados sin discriminación, independientemente de su identidad o antecedentes.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Field Enablement Manager (LATAM)
description:

The Team  Our GTM Enablement team plays a critical role in helping Datadog’s Sales and Customer Success teams succeed by equipping them with the right skills, knowledge, and tools at the right time. We partner closely with teams across Sales, Customer Success, Product Marketing, Curriculum, and Operations to ensure enablement programs translate into real performance in the field.  As Datadog continues to invest in LATAM, this role represents a foundational hire—helping establish how enablement shows up locally while staying tightly connected to our global enablement ecosystem.  The Opportunity  Datadog is growing quickly across Latin America, and we’re looking for our first Field Enablement Manager based in LATAM  to support this momentum. This role will be responsible for delivering ongoing ramp and everboarding enablement  for our Sales and Customer Success teams across LATAM—particularly for sellers and CSMs based in Brazil and Mexico .  In addition, you’ll support Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking sellers based in North America  (e.g., Boston, Denver, Atlanta) who sell into LATAM accounts. You’ll serve as a trusted partner to the field, ensuring global enablement programs land effectively in the local context—across language, culture, sales motion, and market dynamics.  This role is ideal for someone who thrives as an independent operator, builds strong relationships in the field, and enjoys adapting enablement to meet regional needs while staying aligned with global standards. This role will report into the our global Field Enablement team based in New York City and continue partnering with Field Enablement Managers globally across all regions and segments.  What You’ll Do   Deliver live and virtual enablement sessions focused on ongoing ramp and everboarding  for Sales and Customer Success teams across LATAM.  Partner closely with Sales and CS leaders in Brazil and Mexico  to understand performance needs and provide targeted enablement support.  Support Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking sellers based in North America who sell to LATAM customers.  Adapt and localize globally developed enablement programs to ensure relevance across language, culture, market context, and regional sales motions .  Design and facilitate reinforcement activities (e.g., role plays, deal clinics, skill practice sessions) that help sellers apply core concepts in real customer scenarios.  Collaborate closely with the Curriculum team  to share field insights, provide feedback on program effectiveness, and support continuous improvement of global content.  Track participation, collect feedback, and use qualitative and quantitative insights to assess enablement impact and identify opportunities for improvement.  Build trusted relationships with Sales, Customer Success, and cross‑functional partners to diagnose challenges and recommend appropriate enablement interventions.  Act as a regional connector—surfacing LATAM‑specific insights back to global enablement teams to help shape future programs.    Who You Are   3–5 years of experience in sales enablement, field enablement, training, or a related GTM role.  Experience supporting Sales and/or Customer Success teams in a SaaS or technology environment; regional or international experience is a strong plus.  Fluent in Spanish, Portuguese, and English  (required).  Strong facilitator with experience delivering engaging live and virtual training sessions.  Solid business acumen and comfort working with performance data, field feedback, and qualitative insights to inform enablement decisions.  Highly collaborative and relationship-oriented—you build trust quickly with sellers, managers, and cross‑functional partners.  Familiarity with sales methodologies such as MEDDICC or Command of the Message.  Foundational understanding of Datadog’s core product pillars (Infrastructure, APM, Logs) and the ability to connect product capabilities to customer value.  Organized, adaptable, and comfortable operating independently in a fast-growing region.  Scrappy and pragmatic—you enjoy building from the ground up and iterating as you go.  Willing and able to travel approximately 30%  across Latin America and North America.    Why This Role Matters  As Datadog’s first Field Enablement hire in LATAM, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping how enablement supports our sellers and Customer Success teams in the region. You’ll help ensure our global programs translate into local impact—accelerating ramp, improving confidence, and enabling teams to succeed with customers across a rapidly growing market.  Datadog (NASDAQ: DDOG) is a global SaaS business, delivering a rare combination of growth and profitability. We are on a mission to break down silos and solve complexity in the cloud age by enabling digital transformation, cloud migration, and infrastructure monitoring of our customers’ entire technology stacks. Built by engineers, for engineers, Datadog is used by organizations of all sizes across a wide range of industries. Together, we champion professional development, diversity of thought, innovation, and work excellence to empower continuous growth. Join the pack and become part of a collaborative, pragmatic, and thoughtful people‑first community where we solve tough problems, take smart risks, and celebrate one another. Learn more about #DatadogLife on Instagram , LinkedIn, and Datadog Learning Center. Job description Sobre a Rodobens:  Com mais de 70 anos no mercado, a Rodobens é um dos maiores grupos financeiros do Brasil e tem ajudado milhares de pessoas a tirarem seus planos do papel e realizarem seus sonhos, independentemente do tamanho deles. Contando com serviços de: consórcio, empréstimo, concessionárias próprias, financiamentos, seguros, telemedicina, e-commerce pra peças de automóveis, locação de veículos pessoais e de veículos comerciais, a Rodobens tem cada vez mais colocado clientes como o centro de seus valores e prezado pela inovação e praticidade. Por que a Rodobens?  Narrando uma história de conquistas desde 1949, a Rodobens está sediada em São José do Rio Preto, mas possui uma unidade de negócio em São Paulo e diversas concessionárias espalhadas por todo o Brasil. Aqui na Rodobens nós incentivamos que cada pessoa seja ela mesma. Acreditamos que diferentes visões e vivências são essenciais para o desenvolvimento da empresa e para a construção de um ambiente acolhedor. A Rodobens respeita a pluralidade de identidades e trabalha para promover uma cultura inclusiva. Não fazemos distinção de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade em nenhuma etapa do processo seletivo, reforçando nosso compromisso com a diversidade. Saiba mais sobre a área de atuação  Consórcio  A Rodobens Consórcio é uma empresa com mais de 50 anos de experiência e a maior administradora independente do Brasil. Reúne tradição e pioneirismo em seu DNA: foi responsável pelo primeiro consórcio de imóveis do Brasil e formação de grupos nacionais. Atua nos segmentos de automotores (automóveis, veículos comerciais e motos), imobiliário e serviços, com capacidade de formar grupos nacionais, apoiada em uma estrutura de mais de 2.500 pontos de venda. Desde sua fundação, é filiada à Associação Brasileira de Administradoras de Consórcios (Abac), cumprindo as exigências e determinações impostas pelo Banco Central do Brasil para atuar no setor. Tem como visão de negócio ser inovadora, eficiente e comprometida com os ideais e anseios de seus clientes e parceiros. Oferece mais do que produtos diferenciados e os meios mais econômicos e inteligentes de aquisição de bens e serviços, oferece também uma história de solidez e uma disposição permanente para a inovação, que estão expressos em uma palavra: confiabilidade! Main responsibilities Estamos em busca de profissionais que queiram fazer parte do nosso Banco de Talentos com foco em Consórcios . Se você já possui experiência na área ou deseja desenvolver sua carreira em um dos segmentos mais tradicionais e estratégicos da Rodobens, esta é a oportunidade ideal para se conectar conosco. Ao se cadastrar, seu perfil ficará em nosso radar para futuras posições alinhadas às suas competências e ao seu potencial de crescimento. Buscamos pessoas que desejam contribuir para soluções financeiras capazes de transformar vidas e apoiar clientes na realização de seus projetos. Se você quer construir sua trajetória conosco e fazer parte de uma empresa referência no mercado de consórcios, cadastre seu currículo  e participe do nosso Banco de Talentos. Requirements and skills  O que buscamos:  Profissionais com experiência ou forte interesse em produtos de consórcio; Perfil consultivo, com forte habilidade em construir e manter relacionamentos de longo prazo e orientado para resultados, com foco no cliente; Boa comunicação, organização e habilidade para atuar em ambientes dinâmicos; Vivência em vendas, relacionamento com clientes ou rotinas administrativas será um diferencial.  Additional information    Local de trabalho:  Nossas oportunidades estão distribuídas em todas as regiões do Brasil!   Benefícios pra você!  VR ou VA Vale transporte Assistência médica Assistência odontológica Auxílio farmácia Descontos especiais em produtos comercializados pela Rodobens e parceiros credenciados Cursos e treinamentos em várias competências na Universidade Rodobens Seguro de vida em grupo Sessões de psicoterapia PPR Programa de Saúde Financeira – Super Rico Wellhub (antigo Gympass) Clube de Vantagens Rodobens: Descontos especiais em produtos e serviços. Implementar melhores práticas de cada plataforma em segmentação, lançamentos e formatos criativos. Vivência com definição estratégias de retail media, incluindo calendários sazonais, alinhamento promocional e segmentação de audiência. Experiência colaborando com times multifuncionais (marca, vendas, analytics) e agências externas. Domínio de ferramentas como DSPs, dashboards analíticos, Excel e PowerPoint. Adaptabilidade e curiosidade: interesse em se manter atualizado sobre tendências e novidades em retail media. Inglês avançado para conexão com times regionais e globais. description:

About the Role As a Sr. Staff Software Engineer in Core Services, you are a technical anchor for the foundational systems that power every Uber trip, delivery, and transaction globally. Your scope extends beyond a single team; you will define the 2-3 year technical vision for Uber’s backend ecosystem. You will be responsible for the health, scalability, and evolution of our most critical infrastructure—Identity, Payments, and Safety—ensuring they remain resilient as we scale to the next 100 million users. You will act as a peer to Directors and VPs, providing the technical grounding for Uber's most ambitious business goals. What You'll Do Define the North Star: Lead the creation of a multi-year technical roadmap for Core Services, ensuring our architecture handles 10x growth while reducing systemic complexity. Architectural Governance: Serve as a key member of the Architecture Review Board, setting standards for how backend services are built, deployed, and interconnected company-wide. Buy vs. Build: Lead high-stakes evaluations for foundational technologies (databases, orchestration, messaging) that have long-term financial and operational impact.  Systems Transformation & Excellence Solve the "Impossible": Directly tackle the most ambiguous, high-risk technical challenges that represent significant single points of failure for the company. Institutionalize Reliability: Drive a company-wide shift toward "Zero-Trust" and "Always-On" architectures, re-engineering the platform to make entire classes of failures impossible. Efficiency at Scale: Lead initiatives to optimize infrastructure spend and resource utilization across tens of thousands of nodes without compromising performance.  Cross-Functional & Industry Influence Strategic Advisory: Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership (VP/CTO level), translating complex technical trade-offs into business risks and opportunities. Ecosystem Leadership: Represent Uber in the broader tech community (open source, conferences, standards bodies), positioning Uber's engineering as an industry gold standard. Culture Carrier: Champion quality and long-term thinking, modeling Uber’s core values of "Go Get It" and "Build with Heart."  Mentorship of Leaders Leader of Leaders: Focus mentorship on Staff Engineers and Engineering Managers, helping them grow into organizational leaders and strategic thinkers. Sponsor Excellence: Identify and sponsor high-potential talent, ensuring a diverse and robust pipeline of future technical leaders.  Minimum Qualifications 15+ years of professional experience in backend software engineering, with a proven track record of delivering massive-scale distributed systems. History of Org-Wide Impact: Demonstrated ability to lead technical transformations that affect hundreds of engineers and multiple business units. Deep Mastery of Distributed Theory: Expert-level understanding of CAP theorem trade-offs, consensus algorithms (Paxos/Raft), and global data consistency models. Exceptional Communication: Ability to explain deep technical concepts to non-technical executives and build consensus across conflicting organizational priorities.  Preferred Qualifications Open Source Contribution: Significant contributions to major open-source projects in the infrastructure or distributed systems space. Vertical Expertise: Deep experience in FinTech (Payments) or Identity/Security at a global "Big Tech" scale. Future-Proofing: Experience migrating monolithic architectures to highly modular, cell-based, or serverless paradigms at scale.  Uber's mission is to reimagine the way the world moves for the better. Here, bold ideas create real-world impact, challenges drive growth, and speed fuelds progress. What moves us, moves the world - let’s move it forward, together. Offices continue to be central to collaboration and Uber’s cultural identity. Unless formally approved to work fully remotely, Uber expects employees to spend at least half of their work time in their assigned office. For certain roles, such as those based at green-light hubs, employees are expected to be in-office for 100% of their time. Depende da sazonalidade de vendas de projetos, necessidade de aumento da equipe e/ou necessidade de substituições e, assim que chegam, vamos atrás das pessoas certas para compor as equipes. Se você busca um lugar para inovar, aprender e crescer, a CondoConta é o seu próximo passo. Você Fará Brilhar Nossos Olhos Se Tiver   Conhecimento de técnicas interpretáveis (ex: SHAP, LIME, árvores de decisão);  Vivência com dados financeiros, antifraude, concessão de crédito ou política de risco;  Experiência com plataformas como BigQuery, Databricks ou ferramentas de versionamento de modelos (MLflow).    Benefícios De Fazer Parte Da CondoConta   Contratação que facilita sua autonomia financeira;  Reembolso por dias presenciais (para quem está no modelo híbrido em Florianópolis);  Equipamentos para trabalhar com conforto;  Gympass e Conexa Saúde para cuidar do corpo e da mente;Auxílio home office;Day off no aniversário e por tempo de empresa;e outros benefícios para apoiar sua jornada dentro e fora do trabalho. ABOUT THE KINGS LEAGUE  Created and organized by Kosmos, the Kings League has become a global phenomenon that has revolutionized the way we understand football and sports. A new 7-a-side football league with teams chaired by the world's best streamers and content creators, with revolutionary rules aimed at uniting the best of football with the latest trends in esports and new ways of communicating and understanding the world. In this sense, the Kings League has not only managed to "reimagine the game," but has also elevated sport and entertainment to a new dimension, making it more accessible to all audiences.  ABOUT THE ROLE  The regional Franchise Business Manager is a key partner to Kings League franchises (teams and sublicensees). You’ll work directly with franchises to build sustainable, professional, and profitable businesses, while aligning Kings League’s brand, product, and operational standards.  You’ll shape a new model of football entertainment through a creator-led, digital-first league that is redefining fan engagement. You’ll have real ownership and impact, managing a region and directly influencing revenue potential, business strategy, and profitability for Kings League franchises.  The position combines strategic thinking with hands‑on execution, providing exposure to senior leaders, athletes, creators, and global brand partners, all within a fast‑paced, high‑growth environment where ideas move quickly from concept to reality. It’s a unique opportunity to learn, lead, and innovate while helping scale a truly global sports and entertainment ecosystem.  KEY RESPONSIBILITIES   Serve as the primary business contact for assigned Kings League franchises, working closely with club presidents and management teams.  Lead regular business reviews (bi‑weekly, monthly, quarterly) to track performance and drive accountability.  Support franchise commercial strategy, including sponsorship packages, pricing, targets, forecasts, and sales materials.  Proactively identify new revenue opportunities for franchises, in line with Kings League’s global strategy.  Monitor and analyze KPIs across revenue, digital/media performance, costs, and profitability, identifying risks and upside opportunities.  Support budgeting, financial planning, and profit optimization initiatives.  Identify and facilitate strategic introductions between franchises and relevant investors, sponsors, and ecosystem partners, in coordination with Kings League leadership.  Support franchise content, marketing, and fan engagement strategies working cross‑functionally with Kings League’s global, digital‑first model.  Coordinate closely with internal commercial, marketing, finance, content, and operations teams to ensure alignment, execution, and follow‑through.  Facilitate workshops and best‑practice sharing across the Kings League ecosystem.    QUALIFICATIONS   5+ years of experience in consulting, operations, finance, corporate development, strategy, or strategic commercial roles.  Strong business orientation with proven analytical and financial acumen (budgeting, P&L analysis, forecasting).  Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills.  Proactive, resourceful, and comfortable operating in a fast‑paced, entrepreneurial environment.  Strong understanding of digital media, content‑driven brands, or sports/entertainment ecosystems preferred.  Fluency in English, Portuguese & Spanish.  Ability to work effectively across departments, regions, cultures, and time zones.    DIVERSITY & INCLUSION COMMITMENT  At Kings League we strongly believe in building an inclusive and diverse work environment, where everyone can develop their full potential. We are committed to integrating people with any profile, independently of gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, origin and/or disability status, and fostering a team where everyone has the opportunity to contribute and grow. If you meet the requirements of the position, we invite you to send us your application; we value the richness that diversity brings and look forward to welcoming your talent and experience.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

description:

About Us  Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer‑led products, and we’re always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at:   About The Role  Ruby Labs is looking for a CRO Manager – someone who lives and breathes conversion optimization and delivers measurable results. In this role, you’ll have a clear mission: deliver 15% conversion rate growth in a quarter. Unlike companies where CRO specialists simply make recommendations, you’ll drive the entire process: from data analysis and hypothesis generation to creating high‑fidelity mockups, collaborating with developers on implementation, and ultimately owning the performance outcomes. At Ruby Labs, we’ve built a compensation structure that directly rewards those who exceed targets – top performers see substantial financial growth tied directly to their impact. If you’re ready to apply your optimization talents in an environment where excellence is expected and rewarded, we want to talk to you.  Key Responsibilities   Lead end‑to‑end optimization cycles: research → hypothesis → design → testing → rollout.  Conduct in‑depth funnel analysis and competitive benchmarking to identify high‑impact opportunities.  Design high‑quality UI/UX mockups that clearly communicate your vision and maintain brand integrity.  Partner with engineers to ensure flawless test implementation and deployment.  Maintain uncompromising attention to detail and quality throughout the process.  Analyze test outcomes with statistical rigor, making confident scaling decisions.  Document learnings and build a systematic testing roadmap for continuous conversion growth.  Present insights and results clearly to stakeholders, building alignment and momentum.    Qualifications   Proven CRO Results: 3+ years of hands‑on CRO experience, ideally with subscription or SaaS funnels, with documented performance lifts.  Design Sensibility: Strong UI/UX understanding, able to create compelling, detailed mockups.  Analytical Expertise: Skilled in platforms such as Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Growthbook (or similar).  Execution Excellence: Remarkable attention to detail with a bias for action in fast‑moving environments.  Ownership Mentality: Self‑driven, proactive, and comfortable being fully accountable for performance outcomes.  Communication: Clear, persuasive communicator with strong English skills (written and spoken).  Fluent English: Strong written and verbal communication skills.    Nice to have   Experience with BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or similar).  Exposure to marketing attribution models, UTM parameters, and ROAS measurement.  Strong project management skills with the ability to prioritize and execute quickly.  Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.    What we offer to High Performers   A merit‑based environment where performance directly impacts compensation.  Substantial bonus structure tied to exceeding KPI targets.  Rapid career advancement for those who consistently deliver.  Autonomy to implement your vision without bureaucratic barriers.  Opportunity to work with a team that moves fast and values excellence.    Location  Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.  Benefits   Remote Work Environment: Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work‑life balance.  Unlimited PTO: Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well‑being, without counting days.  Paid National Holidays: Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge.  Company‑provided MacBook: Experience seamless productivity with top‑notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them.  Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement: Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Read more about it here:     Interview Process   Recruiter Screening (40 minutes)  Home Task Assignment  First Interview (60 minutes)  Final Interview (45 minutes)    Life at Ruby Labs  At Ruby Labs, we move fast, aim high, and expect the same from our team. We’re not here to play small – we’re here to build, grow, and win. That means we look for people who are ambitious, driven, and ready to give their best every single day. This is a place for individuals who thrive under pressure, embrace challenges, and see opportunity in every obstacle. If you’re hungry to achieve, motivated by impact, and want to grow at the speed of your own ambition, Ruby Labs offers the platform to make it happen. Here, effort is matched with reward. We recognize those who go all in and deliver results, and we create space for people who want more – more responsibility, more growth, and more success.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

description:

Liderança e desenvolvimento:   Mentorar profissionais júnior em competências técnicas e estratégicas;  Contribuir com projetos de melhoria contínua na área de segurança;  Conduzir treinamentos e ações de conscientização sobre segurança;  Representar a área em fóruns, comitês e reuniões técnicas. Monitoramento e Resposta a Incidentes:   Experiência com análise forense (ex: FTK, Volatility) e gerenciamento de vulnerabilidades (ex: Nessus, Qualys);  Familiaridade com soluções de DLP, UEBA, firewalls NGFW, e-mail security, CASB e SSPM.    Ameaças e Testes:   Conhecimento em Threat Intelligence (ex: MITRE ATT&CK, Mandiant);  Execução ou apoio em testes de invasão (Pentest) e simulações Red Team;  Noções de engenharia reversa e análise de malware (diferencial). description:

Responsabilidades   Analisam amostras de materiais biológicos, bromatológicos e ambientais. Para tanto coletam e preparam amostras e materiais. Selecionam equipamentos e insumos, visando o melhor resultado das análises finais para posterior liberação e emissão de laudos. Desenvolvem pesquisas técnico-científicas. Atuam em bancos de sangue e de células tronco hematopoiéticas. Operam equipamentos de diagnósticos por imagem e de radioterapia. Participam na produção de vacinas, biofármacos e reagentes. Executam reprodução assistida e circulação extracorpórea. Podem prestar assessoria e consultoria técnico-científica. Trabalham seguindo normas e procedimentos de boas práticas específicas de sua área de atuação.  Processar os exames do laboratório.  Realizar coleta e preparo de materiais.  Receber, triar, conferir, centrifugar e distribuir para os setores amostras biológicas para análises.  Executar procedimentos atribuídos a sua bancada, priorizando a liberação dos resultados.  Liberação dos resultados dos exames após análise do controle de qualidade, análise de exame e correlações clínicas.  Monitorar as pendências de coleta e/ou resultados de exames.  Realizar e avaliar o controle de qualidade interno e externo dos exames realizados.  Controlar, acompanhar e registrar as manutenções preventivas e corretivas dos equipamentos.  Realizar a manutenção dos equipamentos.  Digitar mapas de trabalho, quando não interfaceados, e liberar exames no interfaceamento.  Efetuar o controle de estoque e pedido de materiais, considerando o consumo/perdas de cada item utilizado no setor.  Prestar esclarecimentos de exames aos médicos e aos pacientes.  Ser responsável pelo laboratório e/ou posto de coleta, garantindo o bom funcionamento do laboratório.  Arquivar dados brutos (mapas de trabalho, planilhas, relatórios) do seu setor.  Implantar e executar programas e ferramentas da qualidade assegurando a padronização.  Exercer o papel de multiplicador, estimulando e repassando conhecimentos técnicos e científicos e treinando os novos colaboradores.  Dar apoio aos colaboradores em dúvidas técnicas e esclarecimento de dúvidas a clientes.  Auxiliar nos processos do SGQ inerentes às suas áreas.  Comunicar-se com os clientes para discutir resultados, fazer recomendações e agendar testes/recoletas adicionais, se necessário.  Garantir o registro preciso dos dados cadastrais e o monitoramento dos procedimentos dos pacientes, e também de possíveis amostras de UBS/CLÍNICAS/PARCEIROS entre outros.  Manter registros de estoque e atualizar equipamentos e suprimentos.  Manter controle de temperaturas, POPs, certificados de calibração/validação de equipamentos/instrumentos disponíveis.  Coordenar a equipe técnica para agendar testes e garantir que os procedimentos adequados sejam seguidos.  Gerenciar contas de clientes e manter registros atualizados.  Realização de pesquisas sobre novos métodos para melhorar a eficiência e a precisão e rotina da unidade.  Garantir a conformidade com todos os protocolos de segurança e rotinas.  Supervisar/liderar equipe, fornecendo instruções e feedback sobre os procedimentos, protocolos, rotinas, instruções da diretoria e de treinamentos/reuniões diversos.  Cumprir com as leis e regulamentos federais, estaduais e locais aplicáveis em relação às operações de laboratório.  Garantir a organização de todo o ambiente de trabalho, desde rotinas de limpeza, manutenção de equipamentos, funcionamento da unidade e rotinas diversas.  Possuir habilidades de liderança para gerenciar sua equipe, o que inclui delegar tarefas, fornecer feedback e motivar os funcionários a seguir os protocolos de segurança e manter a limpeza do laboratório.  Habilidades de comunicação eficazes para o contato com diferentes partes interessadas, incluindo equipe de laboratório, fornecedores, executivos e clientes.  Habilidades de resolução de problemas: identificar e resolver problemas que ocorrem no laboratório e solucionar problemas de equipamentos/dia-a-dia. title: Regional Lobby Manager São Paulo
description:
Empresa está contratando Regional Lobby Manager São Paulo em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Reporting to the Head of Games Operations, the Regional Lobby Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management and optimisation of games lobbies across our LATAM markets, with a primary focus on Brazil and Mexico.  The Regional Lobby Manager will manage the sporty games lobby, ensuring optimal game positioning, effective promotions, strong supplier alignment, and high-quality internal reporting. The role plays a critical part in shaping the player experience and driving performance across the region.  What you'll be doing   Own and manage the sporty games lobby across all core LATAM markets (including BR and MX), ensuring optimal game positioning aligned with commercial strategy and player behaviour  Maximise visibility and discoverability of key games, promotions, and new releases within LATAM lobbies  Upload, schedule, and maintain promotional banners and in-lobby content, ensuring accuracy, relevance, and timely execution  Configure and maintain game settings, limits, and parameters in line with product, commercial, and regulatory requirements  Act as the regional point of contact for supplier needs related to lobby management, promotions, and releases  Partner closely with Product and Tech teams on testing, new feature rollouts, and improvements to categorisation and navigation  Optimise localisation across LATAM markets, ensuring content, naming, and presentation are culturally and linguistically appropriate  Use a data-driven approach to monitor lobby performance, player engagement, and promotional effectiveness, turning insights into actionable improvements  Produce and share clear internal feedback, performance updates, and reports to support decision-making across teams  Manage games-related escalations and operational queries, ensuring timely resolution and effective communication  Plan, coordinate, and map new game releases across LATAM markets, with a particular focus on sporty games  Align closely with Legal and Compliance teams to ensure all lobby content and configurations meet local regulatory requirements  Collaborate on release plans with internal studios and third-party suppliers to ensure smooth execution and strong regional impact    What you'll bring   Proven experience working with online casino games, ideally in lobby management, games operations, or content optimisation  Strong understanding of the LATAM market, particularly Brazil; local market knowledge is highly desirable  Analytical and data-driven mindset, with the ability to interpret performance data and make informed recommendations  Ability to work autonomously while collaborating effectively with globally distributed teams  Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including experience working with suppliers and internal partners  Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, operational environment with competing priorities    What's in it for you   A competitive salary + individual performance based bonuses every quarter  28 days paid annual leave  Top of the line equipment  Annual company retreats to provide great internal networking opportunities    If you're interested, we encourage you to apply! Every application is reviewed by a member of our team (AI is not used in our recruitment process), and we aim to respond within 48 hours.  Sporty is committed to protecting your personal data and ensuring transparent, compliant handling of all information you provide during the application process. Your data will be processed in accordance with applicable privacy laws and retained securely. For details, please review our Privacy Policy.  We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible hiring experience.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: [ 18/09/2025 ] Almoradí se suma al Día Mundial de la Limpieza Almoradí
description:
Empresa está contratando [ 18/09/2025 ] Almoradí se suma al Día Mundial de la Limpieza Almoradí em santos. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

El sábado 20 de septiembre  la Plaza de la Constitución  acogerá, de 10 a 13:30 horas, la XIII Jornada Medioambiental de Almoradí  El Ayuntamiento de Almoradí, a través de la Concejalía de Medio Ambiente que dirige Domingo Andreu  y con el respaldo de la alcaldesa María Gómez , organiza este fin de semana dos citas destacadas en torno a la sostenibilidad y el cuidado del entorno. El sábado 20 de septiembre  la Plaza de la Constitución  acogerá, de 10 a 13:30 horas, la XIII Jornada Medioambiental de Almoradí , un evento ya consolidado en el calendario local. La programación incluye talleres para todas las edades, como “Descubre el mundo de los bichos”, “Plantas aromáticas”, “Huertos urbanos” o “Recicla por el clima”. También habrá exposición de fósiles y minerales, intercambio de ropa sostenible y actividades de concienciación sobre reciclaje y uso responsable de recursos. La jornada contará además con la participación de la Concejalía de Protección Animal, cuyo responsable Víctor Argilés  ha anunciado la presencia de Esprineco , empresa contratada por el Ayuntamiento y centro en el que se encuentran los animales recogidos en la vía pública. Durante la feria se mostrarán algunos de ellos con el objetivo de darles visibilidad y facilitar su adopción. Por su parte, desde la Concejalía de Participación Ciudadana, también dirigida por Víctor Argilés , se instalará un stand donde se realizarán encuestas y se recogerán sugerencias y propuestas vecinales, fomentando así la implicación ciudadana en la mejora del municipio. El domingo 21 de septiembre , Almoradí se sumará al World Clean Up Day , Día Mundial de la Limpieza, en una acción simultánea que se llevará a cabo en varios municipios de la Vega Baja. La actividad está promovida por las asociaciones Vega Baja Limpia  y Mocho Costero , y en el caso de Almoradí tendrá como punto de encuentro el Auditorio Municipal (Calle Torrevieja, 3)  a las 10:00 horas . Desde allí los participantes recorrerán la Ruta del Agua  en una batida de limpieza ciudadana. El Ayuntamiento de Almoradí invita a toda la ciudadanía a participar en estas actividades que buscan sensibilizar sobre la importancia de la sostenibilidad, la protección animal, la reducción de residuos y la conservación del entorno natural. La construcción de este proyecto por parte de TM Grupo Inmobiliario supone una inversión de 140 millones de euros y la generación de miles de empleos directos e indirectos en la ciudad Compártelo: Haz clic (...)   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Brazil Business Development Manager
description:
Empresa está contratando Brazil Business Development Manager em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Khan Academy is a fast‑paced nonprofit with a mission to provide a free, world‑class education to anyone, anywhere. Our proven learning platform offers high‑quality, supplemental content and practice—free of charge—covering core academic subjects from Pre‑K through 12th grade and early college, with a strong focus on math and science. We serve over 200 million registered learners across 190 countries and 55 languages, and we are committed to improving learning outcomes for students worldwide, especially those in historically under‑resourced communities. For more information, please see research findings about Khan Academy and our press center.  OUR COMMUNITY  Our students, teachers, and parents come from all walks of life, and so do we. Our team includes people from academia, education, big tech companies, and startups. We hire great people from diverse backgrounds and experiences because it makes our company stronger. We value diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging as necessary to achieve our mission and impact the communities we serve. We know that transforming education starts in‑house with learning about ourselves and our colleagues. We strive to be world‑class in investing in our people and commit to developing you as a professional.  KHAN ACADEMY BRAZIL  Khan Academy Brazil delivers a world‑class experience, locally relevant with content, programs, and resources for students, teachers, schools, and districts. Our platform is a supplemental digital learning resource that provides interactive, mastery‑based activities for K–12 students in Math, Portuguese, and Science—all aligned with the BNCC. We serve over 11 million learners across our website, apps, and YouTube channels, and our goal is to scale impact through deeper partnerships with public districts and school systems.  ABOUT THE ROLE  Khan Academy Brazil is seeking a Business Development Manager focused on Government Growth to join a small, mission‑driven, highly collaborative team with a big goal: expanding Khan Academy’s reach in Brazilian public education through strategic partnerships and public procurement. This role blends public‑sector business development, partnership strategy, bidding processes, and project management. You will build and manage a pipeline of opportunities with public districts, lead end‑to‑end bid processes, and use our prior partnership experience with school systems as proof points to drive expansion to other districts. If you are comfortable moving between strategic conversations with public education leaders and deep dives into RFPs, bid documents, and implementation details, this role is for you.  Your key responsibilities  Strategic growth   Design and scale partnership models with public districts, aligning Khan Academy’s pedagogical, technological, and financial value proposition with district's priorities  Use our prior partnership experience with public school systems as reference cases, structuring learnings, evidence, and narratives that can be replicated with other districts  Support local leadership in growth strategy for public districts, including sales and marketing efforts, coordinating proposals, presentations, and relationship strategies  Support philanthropic and corporate partnership efforts when relevant, including contributing to proposals, reports, or relationship management    Public‑sector pipeline and bids   Build and manage a structured pipeline of public sector opportunities, mapping priority cities and states, upcoming tenders and public calls, and partnership opportunities  Act proactively in demand generation and pre‑tender influence, where appropriate and compliant, contributing with technical input and reference models  Lead or coordinate the full cycle of public bid responses, including:  Analyzing RFPs, bid documents, terms of reference, and draft contracts  Assessing risks and legal/compliance alignment in close collaboration with legal, finance, and other functional areas  Defining commercial models, scopes, timelines, and success criteria  Preparing and consolidating technical, pedagogical, financial, and institutional documentation  Track timelines, deliverables, clarifications, and potential appeals or challenges throughout the bidding process, in close collaboration with internal and external partners    Implementation and impact   Manage end-to‑end priority partnerships with public school systems, ensuring strong implementation that drives reach, engagement, and measurable learning outcomes for students and educators  Work closely with Khan's partnership functions to design implementation, training, and support plans tailored to each district and use quantitative and qualitative data to track key metrics and propose course corrections  Translate implementation learnings into playbooks for future partnerships with public systems, collaborating with local and international teams to iterate and scale best practices    Stakeholder and relationship building   Build and maintain trust‑based relationships with decision makers in public districts (pedagogical, technical, procurement teams, among others), navigating complex political and institutional environments with empathy, strategic insight, and integrity, in order to drive change management and system‑level adoption of Khan Academy  When relevant, support philanthropic and corporate partnership efforts (funders, foundations, corporate CSR) especially when connected to programs with public districts  Act as a champion for public‑sector partners, educators, and students inside Khan Academy, bringing structured feedback to content, product, support, and strategy teams    ABOUT YOU  What you bring   10+ years of relevant experience in education, business development, consulting, sales to government, public‑sector programs, or large‑scale partnerships, with proven experience selling to or managing contracts with the public sector, ideally in education or govtech, including exposure to public procurement processes and interaction with oversight bodies  At least 3 years managing institutional partner relationships (e.g., customer success, account management, public‑sector program management) and leading complex projects or multi‑stakeholder implementations with clear, measurable outcomes  Strong business development and account management acumen, including the ability to identify new opportunities, build trust with institutional partners, and support proposal and sales cycles in the public sector  Excellent project and program management skills, with a track record of executing high‑impact initiatives across multiple districts or partners simultaneously  Advanced collaboration and influence skills, able to align internal and external stakeholders, manage cross‑functional dependencies, and drive progress without formal authority  Strong strategic and adaptive problem‑solving, able to navigate ambiguity, co‑create solutions with district leaders, and iterate based on evolving needs and political contexts  Excellent communication skills across formats and audiences, including emails, briefs, presentations, and verbal interactions with senior education leaders and technical teams  Comfort and fluency working with qualitative and quantitative data, including analyzing trends, interpreting dashboards, and extracting insights to inform decisions  Outstanding organization and time‑management abilities, capable of coordinating multiple workstreams with high attention to detail  Professionalism, discretion, and integrity, especially when managing sensitive partnerships or navigating politically complex environments  Residency in, or willingness to relocate to, São Paulo, with legal authorization to work in Brazil  Fluency in Portuguese and English, with strong written and verbal communication skills in both languages    You would be a great fit if you have   Experience working with public education systems, NGOs, or government organizations, with a strong understanding of the realities and needs of teachers, school leaders, and district administrators  Demonstrated passion for education equity and innovation, with a commitment to supporting public schools and underserved communities  Proficiency with productivity and collaboration tools, such as Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and project management platforms (e.g., Jira, Trello, Asana, or similar)  Familiarity with AI‑powered tools for content creation, data analysis, or workflow efficiency, with curiosity about leveraging technology to improve educational outcomes  Coaching and facilitation skills, with the ability to support capacity‑building in school systems through empathetic guidance, strategic questioning, and constructive feedback  Experience with or exposure to philanthropic partnerships or CSR initiatives, especially those connected to public education    What is nice to have   Classroom teaching experience, preferably in K–12 settings, which provides valuable perspective when engaging with educators and supporting implementation  First‑hand experience using Khan Academy with students, with insight into how the platform supports instruction differentiation and learning personalization    PERKS AND BENEFITS  We may be a nonprofit, but we take great care of our team. You can expect:   Competitive compensation with healthcare and life insurance benefits  Flexible schedules and generous time off, including personal days beyond standard vacation  A strong focus on professional development and continuous learning  An exceptional team that trusts you, supports you, and gives you autonomy to do your best work  The opportunity to apply your talents to a meaningful mission, contributing to high‑impact offerings that are shaping the future of education  A kind, inclusive, and welcoming workplace, with affinity groups, ally networks, and social activities to help you connect and belong    Live & breathe learners  We deeply understand and empathize with our users. We leverage user insights, research, and experience to build content, products, services, and experiences that our users trust and love. Our success is defined by the success of our learners and educators.  Take a stand  As a company, we have conviction in our aspirational point of view of how education will evolve. The work we do is in service to moving towards that point of view. However, we also listen, learn and flex in the face of new data, and commit to evolving this point of view as the industry and our users evolve.  Embrace diverse perspectives  We are a diverse community. We seek out and embrace a diversity of voices, perspectives and life experiences leading to stronger, more inclusive teams and better outcomes. As individuals, we are committed to bringing up tough topics and leaning into different points of view with curiosity. We actively listen, learn and collaborate to gain a shared understanding. When a decision is made, we commit to moving forward as a united team.  Work responsibly and sustainably  We understand that achieving our audacious mission is a marathon, so we set realistic timelines and we focus on delivery that also links to the bigger picture. As a non‑profit, we are supported by the generosity of donors as well as strategic partners, and understand our responsibility to our finite resources. We spend every dollar as though it were our own. We are responsible for the impact we have on the world and to each other. We ensure our team and company stay healthy and financially sustainable.  Bring out the joy  We are committed to making learning a joyful process. This informs what we build for our users and the culture we co‑create with our teammates, partners and donors.  Cultivate learning mindset  We believe in the power of growth for learners and for ourselves. We constantly learn and teach to improve our offerings, ourselves, and our organization. We learn from our mistakes and aren’t afraid to fail. We don't let past failures or successes stop us from taking future bold action and achieving our goals.  Deliver wow  We insist on high standards and deliver delightful, effective end‑to‑end experiences that our users can rely on. We choose to focus on fewer things — each of which aligns to our ambitious vision — so we can deliver high-quality experiences that accelerate positive measurable learning with our strategic partners.  HOW TO APPLY   Attach your resume or Linkedin URL in the space provided below.  Please address the below‑mentioned task and attach your response in the space provided below.    TASK  Describe a public‑sector partnership or bid process where you played a leading role. In your answer, briefly cover:   The context and goal of the opportunity  The key actions you led (e.g., stakeholder engagement, proposal/bid work, internal alignment)  The outcome and one key learning    Please anonymize any confidential information and limit your response to one page.  We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or Veteran status. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion, and we encourage candidates from historically underrepresented groups to apply.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Você ama vender? Desde 2009, nos consagramos como referência em Gestão Empresarial para pequenas e médias empresas , ajudando empresários a tirar seus sonhos do papel e alcançar resultados reais .Para esta grande missão, estamos sempre em busca de pessoas com muita energia, que têm a vontade de ir além e que sonham grande para somar com a gente em nossa missão.Por que você vai se apaixonar pela 4blue?  Se vocêsonha grande ,tem energia para transformar vidas equer fazer parte de algo realmente relevante , você vai se sentir em casa aqui.  Nosso trabalho vai muito além de "ensinar":nós inspiramos e guiamos empreendedores rumo ao sucesso , ajudando-os a superar desafios sem precisar passar pelo medo de falir ou pelo estresse de não crescer. Aquijogamos para ganhar . Oferecemos cursos e consultorias, avaliamos e damos feedback. Sempre querendo melhorar, sempre jogando para ganhar. Se a empresa ganha, você ganha. Nossaparticipação nos lucros pode te fazer tirar 1, 2, até 3 salários extras no ano! Leveza com responsa . Somos leves e damos risada mesmo quando as coisas estão difíceis. Não gritamos, não brigamos, não humilhamos. Nossagestão é humana e verdadeiramente nos importamos com as pessoas. Sim, somos leves,mas jogamos pra ganhar e vamos ganhar . Home office: mais tempo no seu dia. O que dá pra fazer com 1 a 2 horas a mais no dia? Tem gente que acredita que trabalhar de casa não funciona, aqui provamos que dá sim pra trabalhar de casa com foco e com resultado, mas com muito mais qualidade de vida.  Sobre a vaga: O Consultor Comercial (Closer) é responsável por conduzir reuniões e negociações comerciais, gerenciar o relacionamento com clientes, pelo fechamento de contratos, bem como ajudar a melhorar o processo de vendas para aumentas as taxas de conversão. Sua missão é VENDER! Principais Missões: Realizar reuniões de vendas: Realizar reuniões com os clientes (em média de 4 a 5 por dia) para identificar a necessidade do cliente, apresentar nossa melhor solução e fazer o cliente sentir um desejo incontrolável pela nossa solução; Gestão de relacionamento com clientes: Manter um relacionamento próximo com os clientes, tirando dúvidas, quebrando objeções, buscando o "sim" ou "não" de nossa proposta; Atualização e Gestão do CRM: Registrar as interações e status dos leads, mantendo um controle preciso do funil de vendas; Participação em Treinamentos e Desenvolvimento: Estar em constante desenvolvimento, participando de treinamentos e melhorando as habilidades que aumentem suas taxas de conversão; Apoio ao Time e Melhoria de Processos: Ajudar o time com insights sobre leads, auxiliar na preparação de estratégias de vendas, dar sugestões para melhoria do processo comercial; Disponibilidade para viagens eventuais para participação em eventos presenciais.   RemuneraçãoO Closer receberá uma remuneração fixa compatível com o mercado + variável por performance.As comissões, na média, vão de 3 mil reais a 7 mil reais por mês, porém não há um teto na remuneração, logo estes valores podem se tornar muito superior a depender da performance.O que buscamos de um futuro Blue: Requisitos Essenciais  Habilidade em vendas, boa comunicação verbal e escrita Experiência sólida em vendas consultivas Postura profissional, autoridade e segurança no trabalho Inteligência emocional - saber lidar sob pressão, saber lidar com objeções, saber lidar com o "não" do cliente Espaço silencioso em sua casa para trabalhar  Requisitos desejáveis (serão um baita diferencial):   Conhecimento e experiência em gestão de negócios.  Domínio de Técnicas de Fechamento/Negociação Avançadas (PNL, Spin Selling, etc) Experiência com home office.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Enfermeiro(a) Serviços Hospitalares | Banco de Talentos
description:
Nova oportunidade para Enfermeiro(a) Serviços Hospitalares | Banco de Talentos em agudos. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Enfermeiro(a) Serviços Hospitalares | Banco de Talentos Já pensou em fazer parte do crescimento da maior provedora de produtos e serviços para pacientes com doença renal em todo o mundo? Todas as nossas ações convergem para um só objetivo: promover a saúde e o bem-estar do paciente. Queremos criar um futuro que vale a pena viver! QUEM SOMOS: A Fresenius Medical Care (FME) tem como propósito fundamental melhorar a vida dos pacientes com doença renal crônica (DRC), oferecendo-lhes um serviço integral, caracterizado pela mais alta tecnologia para o tratamento de diálise e o apoio permanente de uma equipe especializada, profissional e comprometida com a saúde do paciente. Graças a este compromisso, a Fresenius Medical Care tornou-se a maior provedora mundial de produtos e serviços para pacientes com doença renal crônica, uma doença que afeta a mais de 3,2 milhões de pessoas em todo o mundo. Provemos serviços de diálise por meio de mais de 3.928 clínicas de diálise em todos os continentes, atendendo a mais de 333.331 pacientes. Enfermeiro(a) - Serviços Hospitalares  O que você irá realizar: Cumprir os processos e atividades de assistência aos pacientes em programa de diálise domiciliar e/ou hospitalar com diagnóstico de injúria renal aguda em recuperação, crônica ou crônica-agudizada submetidos às modalidades de Terapia Renal Substitutiva (TRS), visando garantir a aplicação das melhores práticas no tratamento dialítico incluindo o uso adequado de equipamentos de proteção individual, o cumprimento às rotinas e normas técnicas, operacionais e administrativas estabelecidas pela Franqueadora e legislação vigente, bem como a garantia da sua segurança no ambiente de trabalho.
